reconciliations.observation: PartialReflect first requests Reflect then uses Any downcast for typed reference or mutable reference. Boxed Reflect downcast compares as_any type identity and unwraps a subsequent into_any downcast on matching identity. ReflectDeserialize’s public func is called with an erased deserializer; the standard FromType<T> function calls T::deserialize and boxes the successful typed value. Current declared opaque remote wrappers name AnimationElapsed and UnitInterval; the owners use serde try_from f32 and constructors that reject nonfinite/negative elapsed or nonfinite/out-of-range fractions, respectively. Current state fields declare those remote adapters.
